verdicts.reason: Both are the same layout with the chips shuffled. In both, the SOLSTICE logo is shrunk to an unreadable speck in the top-right corner, the hero can is tiny, and the Build Your Mix CTA is jammed directly under the can and crowds a neighbouring chip. The flavour chips are scattered 3/2 on either side at uneven widths and spacing, and the fine print is too small to read. A has three chips on the left (Elderflower, Pink Peppercorn, Wild Honey) and B has three on the right (Elderflower, Blood Orange, Wild Honey), but neither arrangement is better, so the two are genuinely equivalent.
